items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Joe Robichaux and he mentioned that Elmer Talbot's brother is a dentist. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, well I told you that, Chad.

ctx.x: Oh man, when he didn't have enough patience in his office he'd hear him blowing that horn all day long. And he kept it so beautiful, shine, this is all speak and span, he had a beautiful gold horn. And he kept it speak and span all the time.

I always had his music rack right up there in his office. That's right, that's correct. Speaking of dentists, this morning I rode up the Tulane with Joe Robichaux and he mentioned that Elmer Talbot's brother is a dentist.
Yeah, well I told you that, Chad.
